Acupuncture

Precise care, tailored to you.

Acupuncture uses fine, sterile, single-use needles at carefully selected points as part of an individualized treatment plan.

How acupuncture may support care

Treatment begins with a review of your concerns, health history, medications, and goals. Your practitioner explains the recommended approach before treatment begins.

Your first visit

A calm, informed start.

Eat a light meal beforehand, stay hydrated, and wear comfortable clothing that allows access to your arms and legs. Bring a current medication list and your insurance card if you plan to use benefits.

Schedule by phone

Traditional Chinese Medicine

Herbal care for modern routines.

Traditional formulation principles meet concentrated granules selected for consistency, convenience, and individualized care.

Chinese herbal medicine

Thoughtfully selected and clearly prepared.

We use concentrated Chinese herbal granules, including KPC extracts, selected for consistency and convenience. Powdered formulas dissolve in warm water, avoiding the traditional boiling process.

Formulas may be individualized to a patient’s needs. Pre-designed formulas are also available for general wellness goals.

Use herbal formulas with guidance.

If you are pregnant, nursing, taking medication, or managing a medical condition, speak with your practitioner before use. Follow the directions provided with your formula, and do not share a personalized formula.

Common questions

Before your visit.

A little preparation helps make your first appointment feel easy and focused.

Your first visit starts with a review of your concerns, health history, medications, and goals. Your practitioner will explain the recommended approach and answer questions before treatment begins.

Eat a light meal beforehand, stay hydrated, and wear comfortable clothing. Bring your medication list and insurance card if you plan to use benefits.

Acupuncture needles are very thin. People commonly feel a brief pinch, heaviness, warmth, or tingling. Tell your practitioner at any point if you are uncomfortable.

Yes. The clinic uses presterilized, single-use disposable acupuncture needles.

Follow the directions provided with your formula. Concentrated granules are commonly mixed with warm water. Do not change the dose or share a personalized formula without speaking with your practitioner.

Yes. Choose a formula and size in the herbal store, then pay by card through secure online checkout.

Call to schedule an appointment or ask about insurance. Herbal products are available through the separate online store.

Consent for Treatment

Please read each section before confirming your consent.

Consent to treatment

I voluntarily consent to evaluation and treatment by Yen’s Acupuncture & TCM. Treatment may include acupuncture, Chinese herbal medicine, cupping, heat therapy, and other traditional Chinese medicine techniques recommended for my care. I understand that I may ask questions, decline any part of treatment, or withdraw my consent at any time.

Risks and benefits

I understand that treatment outcomes cannot be guaranteed. Possible benefits and reasonable alternatives have been explained to me. Acupuncture and related therapies may cause temporary soreness, bruising, minor bleeding, fatigue, lightheadedness, or a temporary change in symptoms. Rare risks may include fainting, infection, burns, nerve injury, or injury to an internal organ. Herbal products may cause digestive upset, allergic reactions, or interactions with medication. I agree to tell the practitioner about medications, allergies, pregnancy, implanted devices, and material changes in my health.

Privacy / HIPAA

I understand that my health information will be collected, used, and disclosed for treatment, payment, and health care operations in accordance with applicable privacy law and the clinic’s privacy practices. I may ask the clinic how to access or request an amendment to my records and may raise questions about the handling of my information.

Communication

I consent to the clinic contacting me by phone, voicemail, text message, or email about appointments, forms, billing, and care coordination using the contact information I provide. I understand that ordinary electronic communication may have privacy risks and that I may ask the clinic to update my communication preferences.

Financial responsibility

I understand that insurance benefit information is not a guarantee of payment. I authorize the clinic to submit claims and release the information reasonably needed to process them. I am financially responsible for copays, deductibles, non-covered services, products, and any balance not paid by my insurer.
